Can ChatGPT answer "can I return this?" about your store?

Shoppers now ask AI assistants about shipping, returns and fit before they open a store. We checked 100 Shopify stores to see whether the answers are there to find. This page is the short way in.

Check your own store, freeAsk us to look at it

Or the paid Store Ops Pack, $29. Works in ChatGPT too. Not affiliated with Shopify Inc.

What we found in 100 Shopify stores

Public pages only, checked on 3 October 2026. The sample was chosen by hand, so read every figure as "in this sample". No store is named.

88%

of the 99 stores we could measure have no shipping or return terms in their product structured data. Only 12% have any.

45%

do not clearly state both shipping and returns on their product pages either. An assistant asked "can I return this?" has nowhere reliable to read the answer.

69 words

is the median store's median product description. At 80% of stores, fewer than 85% of products reach 80 words.

The full report, method and limits. The good news in it: 0% of the stores block AI agents, so the gaps are ones you can fix yourself.

1. Check your own store, free

The quickest start is the Agent-Ready Quick Check. Give it your store address and it runs six checks, then compares your store with the 99 we audited.

  • Use ChatGPT or another chatbot? Copy the paste-in prompt. No install, no account on our side.
  • Use an assistant that reads SKILL.md files? npx skills add proskillpacks/skills installs it, and the other free skills, from GitHub.

The other free skills for store owners:

  • Agent-Ready Quick Check: Six checks on how AI shopping agents read your store, compared with 99 stores we audited.
  • Policy Checker: Policy gaps and contradictions across refund, shipping, privacy and terms, with fixes to paste.
  • Alt Text Writer: Alt text for every product image, written while looking at the photo, as an import CSV.
  • Product Title Cleaner: One consistent title pattern across the catalogue, as an import CSV of changed rows only.
  • Review Reply Drafter: A reply for every review, matched to its tone, with the risky ones flagged for you.
  • Chargeback Evidence Checklist: Got a chargeback? The evidence to gather for your dispute reason, what you already have, and where to find each piece in Shopify.

All of them are free to use and change under the MIT licence.
